name: D&D 2024 immutable item activities
description: Closed immutable activity descriptors attached only to a catalog item definition. This first seam supports a fixed consume-and-grant-item activity: the descriptor names exactly what is consumed, what item definition is created, and its direct-container slot. It stores no campaign item id, owner, balance, arbitrary JavaScript, target selector, action cost, check result, magic state, or derived outcome. Governed by procedure.mechanic.dnd2024.item-activity.
